# `vox-diagram`

**Crate:** `vox-diagram` · **Version:** `0.6.0` · **Target:** Library (`lib.rs`)

Pure VoxDiagram core: graph DSL lexer, error-recovering parser, resolved IR, diagnostics with machine-applicable fixes, canonical formatter, markdown fence scanner, dagre graph layout and a deterministic SVG renderer.

## Crate Overview

VoxDiagram core: graph and sequence DSL lexer, error-recovering parser, resolved IR,
`diagram/*` diagnostics with machine-applicable fixes, canonical formatter, markdown fence
scanner, graph layout and deterministic SVG rendering of both kinds.
Pure and synchronous: no I/O, no async runtime, no workspace dependencies.

```text
graph {
node a: "A"
node b: "B"
a -> b
}
```


## Public API Surface

### Modules

| Module | Description |
|---|---|
| `ast` | Syntax tree produced by the parser. |
| `codes` | Stable `diagram/*` diagnostic codes. |
| `diag` | Diagnostics, fixes and the check report. |
| `fence` | Markdown fenced-block scanner shared by every diagram consumer. |
| `ir` | Resolved serialisable diagram IR. |
| `limits` | Named input caps. |
| `mermaid` | Mermaid export (verified against a pinned real Mermaid parser) and strict, fail-closed Mermaid import. |
| `sequence_ir` | Sequence diagram IR types, the payload of `Ir::Sequence`. |
| `span` | Byte spans and line/col locations. |
| `svg` | Deterministic, injection-safe, themeable SVG rendering of graph and sequence diagrams (graph layout through the dagre adapter). |
| `validate` | One-call validation envelope (check, canonical form, optional Mermaid import and SVG/Mermaid emit) shared by the MCP tool and the CLI. |

### Constants

| Constant | Description |
|---|---|
| `GRAMMAR_CARD` | The VoxDiagram grammar card (graph and sequence) for agent authoring guidance. It is appended to the `vox_validate_diagram` MCP tool description and published verbatim in `docs/src/reference/vox-diagram.md`; `tests/grammar_card.rs` keeps the two in sync. |
